name: zoo
description: A macOS menu bar app that shows one small monster for every running agent session.

scripts.app:install: npm run app:build && (pkill -x zoo || true) && ditto src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/zoo.app "$HOME/Applications/zoo.app" && rm -rf src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/zoo.app && open "$HOME/Applications/zoo.app"
